summary: Self-service automation portal has a Feedback form, disabled by default and enabled by an administrator in portal config. Click Feedback, enter text, tick 'I understand that feedback is shared with Red Hat', and Submit. Exclude the portal URL from ad blockers so feedback reaches Red Hat.
questions: How do I give feedback in self-service automation portal?
Why is the Feedback button missing in self-service automation portal?
Why isn't my self-service portal feedback reaching Red Hat?
